schema.label: Gross margin
schema.formula: gross profit ÷ revenue, where gross profit is reported or, when only the cost is reported, revenue − cost of revenue

schema.label: Revenue growth
schema.formula: revenue ÷ prior-year revenue − 1, using the same XBRL concept

schema.label: Net income growth
schema.formula: net income ÷ prior-year net income − 1, only when the prior year was positive

schema.label: Free cash flow
schema.formula: operating cash flow − capital expenditure (calculated, not reported)

schema.label: Debt-to-equity
schema.formula: long-term debt (noncurrent) ÷ stockholders’ equity, only when equity is positive

schema.label: Return on assets
schema.formula: net income ÷ total assets at year end

schema.label: Return on equity
schema.formula: net income ÷ stockholders’ equity at year end, only when equity is positive
